title: plan.json — chapters and the person's ledger

title.description: Concrete — a place, a year, an act (voice.md §12).

summary.description: One or two sentences for the StoryMaker outline: what happens in this chapter. `cite.py outline` and `cite.py land` set it.

events.description: Dossier event ids this chapter tells. Their share of all allotted events sets the chapter's ceiling.

ledger.description: Ledger row ids that change in this chapter — the prose must show each (voice.md §8).

floorWords.description: Written by richness.py plan: thresholds.starvedFraction of this chapter's share of plan.targetWords (or of the dossier's ceiling when there is no target). Under it, voice_lint reports the chapter starved.

role.description: A pivotal-history story's last chapter may be its afterword (domain voice §12): no events, its own length (thresholds afterword.words), the writer's share up to writer.afterwordMaxShare.

turn.description: What the reader wants to know next: the chapter ends on it, never on a summary (domain voice §10).

introduces.description: The cast entries (dossier people[] / peoples[] `name`) this chapter introduces at their first meeting (domain voice §11). richness.py plan fails an entry no chapter introduces.

pictures.description: What a reader of this chapter should SEE (the double ring in section; the stakes): the wants images.py find and illustrate work from (domain voice §13).

question.description: The question the book answers, which the introduction asks (a pivotal-history story, domain voice §10).

intro.description: The introduction's plan: `introduces`, the cast entries it meets (domain voice §10, §11).

observations.description: Two to four one-liners that make the episode worth telling (domain voice §12), each with the chapter that lands it, the events that carry it, and phrases (`shows`) the prose will contain. editor.py check notes one that never lands.

field.description: A packKey from the story's bible pack: story/schemas/biography.json for a life (bio.occupation), story/schemas/campaign.json for a pivotal episode (campaign.strength); the domain's voice.md names its pack.

shows.description: Phrases any one of which shows the change in the prose; default [value].

targetWords.description: Optional. The length the planner chooses, no larger than the dossier's ceiling (D2: the ceiling is a maximum, not a quota). It lowers each chapter's starved floor and never its ceiling.

endNote.description: Why the story stops before the record does, when it does (voice.md §4).
